授权等待不占执行名额；下单、核验分别建模。演示假设 API 正常返回。生产系统还: Authorization waits occupy no execution slot. Ordering and verification are separate steps. APIs are assumed to respond normally. Production needs timeouts, cancellation, idempotency, persistence and recovery. After an uncertain response, check order status before retrying payment. A verified receipt completes the ordering task, not delivery of the coffee.
服务通常已部署，模型依赖 GPU/NPU 单卡或兼容的多卡组，工具通常使用 CP: Services are usually already deployed. Models use a GPU/NPU card or compatible multi-card group; tools typically use CPU, network and external APIs. This is a responsibility model and does not require separate deployment of the Agent and executor.

路由选的是服务实例；不在这里选择本轮token批次或重新放置设备。缓存感知是候选: Routing selects a service instance; it neither forms the current token batch nor relocates devices. Cache-aware routing needs observable cache state.

观察窗口内，同时满足质量、时限与成本要求的完成任务数 ÷ 窗口秒数。用于衡量固定: Tasks completed within the observation window that meet quality, deadline and cost requirements, divided by window duration in seconds. Measures useful delivery under fixed resources.

同批次全部尝试成本 ÷ 达标任务数，包含失败、重试、迁移与调度开销；分母为零时不: All attempt costs in the cohort divided by compliant completions, including failures, retries, migration and scheduling. Undefined when no task qualifies.
